Name: Frostbound Finale
Desc: While casting <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst</color>, the cast timing of <color=#D91414>Concerto Orb</color> and <color=#D91414>Rhythmic Piercing</color> can be moved up. When not carrying the Glaciation Effect, the first use of <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst</color> upon each switch-in triggers <color=#D91414>Time Lag Calculation</color>. After using <color=#D91414>Rhythmic Piercing</color>, the next use of <color=#D91414>Signature - Majestic Interlude</color> deals <color=#D91414>100%</color> increased Base DMG. This effect cannot stack and is retained when switched out. After using <color=#D91414>Signature - Note of Termination</color>, the next <color=#D91414>Basic Attack - Echoing Melody</color> gains an additional <color=#D91414>15 Signature Energy</color>. When carrying the Glaciation Effect, while Ice Spikes persist, the Glaciation DMG of <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst and Signature - Note of Termination</color> increases by <color=#D91414>50%</color>, and the Glaciation DMG of <color=#D91414>Signature - Majestic Interlude</color> increases by <color=#D91414>100%</color>.

Name: Entwined Dreams
Desc: When casting <color=#D91414>Signature - Dream Dive</color>, clears all flying blades and converts them into an equal number of Blue Orbs; triggers Matrix if it is not on cooldown, and activates QTE if it is not on cooldown. Each time the character enters battle, the first cast of <color=#D91414>Lightstack</color> grants <color=#D91414>7</color> Signature Energy. Casting <color=#D91414>Signature - Mirrored Renewal</color> grants <color=#D91414>15</color> Signature Energy. While not in <color=#D91414>Dark Avatar</color>, <color=#D91414>Signature - Mirrored Renewal</color>'s Base DMG increases by <color=#D91414>135%</color>, and DMG dealt by <color=#D91414>Dawn Dream</color> increases by <color=#D91414>200%</color>; if <color=#D91414>Dream Dive</color> is active, the Base DMG bonus each Signal Orb grants to <color=#D91414>Thousand Rays</color> increases to <color=#D91414>40%</color>. While in <color=#D91414>Dark Avatar</color>, <color=#D91414>Signature - Mirrored Renewal</color>'s Base DMG increases by <color=#D91414>45%</color>, and <color=#D91414>Dawn Dream</color>'s Darkflow DMG increases by <color=#D91414>60%</color>; if <color=#D91414>Dream Dive</color> is active, the Base DMG bonus each Signal Orb grants to <color=#D91414>Thousand Rays</color> increases to <color=#D91414>30%</color>.
